rows.grounds: compound: śrīmat (glorious, auspicious) + aṣṭākṣarī (eight-syllabled); qualifies a mantra/vidyā in mantra-centred worship context (Transmission brief: mantra as deity's sound-form)
vidyā in tantric usage denotes a mantra/formula; read in context of mantra recitation (Transmission brief: mantra-centred worship of Rāma/Viṣṇu)
compound: japa (recitation, muttering) + saṃkalpa (resolve, intention); ritual preliminary to utterance (Transmission brief: ritual sequences include japa)
verb of uttering/reciting; prescribes vocalization of the mantra (Transmission brief: mantra-centred ritual action)
